premise.dramatic_question: Will {HEROES} piece together what became of {MAKER} and help the tower remember what it lost?
resolution_space: the archive teaches them the tower's real history, arming a better-prepared return
a page in the archive holds a copy of the note, carried home so the translation can continue
closing time arrives mid-chapter and the keeper gently shows them out with a borrowing promise
a sober look at the crossing convinces them the cost of a slip outweighs finishing his story tonight
one friend names the risk aloud and the others agree, recognizing it as the same risk he once weighed
a slip caught in time turns the attempt into a calm, deliberate retreat
random guessing trips a protection he built, freezing the setting until a keeper resets it
the closing signal sounds before any guess lands, and the tower must empty for the night, his last setting still unfinished
the overworked mechanism raises a polite fuss that brings the keeper up to close for the night
the forced works bind fast, and nothing they carry tonight will move them
a bent linkage needs a workshop tool nobody brought, exactly the kind he kept on hand
the keeper's posted rule ends forcing attempts at nightfall, and they honor it in his memory
the workshop adopts them as its quiet caretakers, and caring for it becomes a way of keeping him close
some ongoing work in the room invites their hands, and continuing it becomes their standing project
his notes name whoever finds the room its steward, and they accept, as if he had been waiting
the recovered story is shared publicly and the settlement remembers him properly at last
the recovered story quietly restores something the settlement had lost along with him
the recovery earns the keeper's trust and a standing invitation back to the tower he loved
a pact sworn over the keepsake binds the friends as the quiet keepers of his memory
they leave everything exactly as found, keeping the story and leaving the rest
his letter asks its finders to choose, and they choose to keep his memory close instead of loud
his old safeguard announces the grab, and the keeper arrives before the door
what they carry out is exactly what springs the safeguard he built for this exact moment
second thoughts slow them just enough for the keeper's evening rounds to find them mid-return

label_styles: terse imperatives, three words where possible
first-person plural resolves: what we do next
question-forms at decisions, statements at continues
name the place or thing, let the action stay implied

facts.tower_forgotten: the clocktower stands locked, treated by the settlement as a closed chapter
facts.farewell_found: a coded farewell note is still pinned to the door, waiting for someone to read it
facts.friends_stand_together: the friends stand at the discovery together, no one reading it alone
facts.search_begun: the friends decide to find out what really became of the maker
facts.first_line_translated: translating the note's first line recovers one true fact about the maker's last days
facts.place_named: the translated line names a specific place tied to the maker's old routine
facts.traces_found: two overlooked traces of the maker's routine, a low one and a high one, are found independently
facts.keeper_remembers: the keeper, once drawn out, is met and willing to remember out loud
facts.memory_offered: the keeper offers both a way in and a personal memory of the maker
facts.departure_understood: why the maker withdrew and hid something is understood, and the reason was kind
facts.crossed_the_threshold: the friends are inside, whatever led them there
facts.maker_wings_known: four wings of the maker's old routine are known: the climb, the study, the crossing, the depths
facts.timeline_piece_held: the friends hold one true piece of the maker's timeline, its source varying by room
facts.archive_holds_them: the study's records tempt the friends to read the whole history right there
facts.crossing_recalls_risk: the crossing room still carries the real risk the maker once respected
facts.keepsake_glimpsed: something the maker once treasured is visible across the crossing
facts.at_the_old_clock: the friends reach the maker's last known project: the tower's own clock
facts.clock_riddle_live: the clock's face poses a legible question about the maker's final, unfinished setting
facts.clock_restored: the mechanism is set as the maker intended, and the tower's memory runs true again
facts.clock_seized: forcing the setting seizes the mechanism instead of restoring it
facts.second_note_found: a second, smaller note is found behind the clock's face
facts.chamber_entered: the friends stand in the chamber the maker's last work protected
facts.chamber_seen: what the chamber holds is understood: the maker's letter and modest things that belong to everyone
facts.left_with_dignity: the friends leave intact, whatever happened; the outcome is a fact, never a disgrace
facts.search_can_resume: the search can pick up again another day; nothing is lost for good
facts.set_right_with_keeper: whatever was disturbed is restored and explained honestly to the keeper
facts.workshop_uncovered: the maker's living workshop is uncovered past the second note
facts.legacy_accepted: the friends accept care of the maker's unfinished legacy
facts.memory_restored_publicly: the maker's story is returned to the settlement, restoring what it had forgotten
facts.memory_kept_privately: the maker's story is kept as a private inheritance among the friends
facts.kinship_formed: the shared search forms a lasting kinship among the friends
facts.keeper_returns: the keeper turns up in the moment of temptation, exactly when needed

safety_envelope.affect_ceiling: suspense with wonder and mild urgency; tension may tighten but never tips into threat

cipher_forms.note: one cipher form per story, chosen at bind and used consistently from note to clockface to back panel

access_details.note: one concrete way in per approach branch: the note's decoded route and the building's own weak point draw freely; the keeper's branch stays person-mediated

cipher_hint_carriers.note: one per exploration room, drawn freely; unique_within_story gives each book four different carriers, and each carries enough logic that any single room makes the dial attemptable

room_curiosities.note: what makes each room distinct and worth the visit beyond its hint

vault_contents.note: the vault protects knowledge, heritage, and wonder; any treasure is modest and communal, never loot

obstacle_kinds.note: physical difficulty stays honest and non-injurious; failure costs time or access, never safety

safeguards.note: the maker's anti-taking measure; gentle and funny, it embarrasses no one and hurts no one

remedies.note: the honest way back from a jam, on the machine's own terms; care, patience, or wit, never strength

loft_signatures.note: the one detail that makes the maker's hidden room feel currently alive rather than preserved

affect.target: curious ache, the pull of an unfinished goodbye

cipher_form.note: the story's one cipher form; every later translation-beat renders it consistently

choice_semantics.c_open: read the note as what it is, someone's last word, and take it seriously together

n_open.beat_hint: an old farewell is still waiting to be read, and reading it together is the story's real beginning.

affect.target: curious ache, choosing which trace of the maker to follow

constraints.offers_must_be: three genuinely different traces of the maker to follow: his words, his building, his people; no option is the smart one
constraints.must_not: translate any of the note here; the split happens before anyone recovers a fact

choice_semantics.c_examine: follow the maker's own words: work the note
choice_semantics.c_door: follow the maker's handiwork: read the building itself
choice_semantics.c_keeper: follow the maker's confidant: ask who still remembers

n_start.beat_hint: before recovering anything, the friends decide whose trace to follow first: his words, his walls, or his people.

affect.target: the small, grief-tinged satisfaction of learning one true thing

access_route.note: the translated line names one concrete place: where it hides or how it works, plus a plain first step

constraints.decode_must_be: shown on the page in the story's one cipher form, so a reader can play along; first line only
constraints.must_not: make the translation trivial or make the other traces look foolish for not trying it

choice_semantics.c_note_key: chase the named place down properly
choice_semantics.c_note_inside: act on the plain reading and go there directly

n_note.beat_hint: translating just the opening line recovers one true fact, and that fact quietly points two directions.

affect.target: quiet detective focus on what the building itself remembers

access_route.note: the building's own overlooked route; using it reads as reading his habits, never as damage

constraints.entry_must_read: as clever reading of a neglected building's routine, not as break-in
constraints.must_not: carry any translation knowledge; this branch has not read the note closely

choice_semantics.c_door_force: read the low, worn path he used often
choice_semantics.c_door_window: read the high, less-worn path he used rarely

n_door.beat_hint: walking his old routes without him leaves two separate traces of habits nobody else noticed.

affect.target: gentle patience coaxing a reluctant memory into the open

access_route.note: kept person-mediated on purpose: this branch's whole meaning is a person's memory, not a trick

constraints.keeper_must_be: gruff on the surface, glad underneath that someone finally asked about him; an adult who takes kids seriously
constraints.must_not: have the keeper translate the note for them or forbid the attempt

choice_semantics.c_keeper_enter: take the offered way in and go now
choice_semantics.c_keeper_story: stay for the memory before the way in

n_keeper.beat_hint: coaxing a reluctant memory out of someone is repaid with both a way in and a story.

affect.target: the small thrill of a hunch panning out

constraints.payoff_must_be: the way in exactly where the translated line promised; the world confirms the note told the truth
constraints.must_not: introduce a second puzzle here; this beat is confirmation, not complication

choice_semantics.c_keyhunt_in: use the confirmed lead and go in the way it points

n_keyhunt.beat_hint: the world confirms the translated line was telling the truth about him all along.

affect.target: hushed listening, sympathy for a private choice

constraints.history_must_be: warm and specific: the maker withdrew out of care, not fear or shame; motive stays kind while details stay secret
constraints.must_not: reveal what the chamber holds or how the clock's setting resolves

choice_semantics.c_story_in: carry the understood departure inside, entering already knowing why he left

n_keeper_story.beat_hint: hearing why he really withdrew turns every later clue into recognition instead of guesswork.

affect.target: a small thrill, then the hush of standing where he once stood

constraints.climb_must_be: exciting but visibly safe: short height, good holds, friends spotting each other
constraints.must_not: injure anyone or play the climb as recklessness

choice_semantics.c_window_in: commit to the drop, cross into the maker's world

n_window.beat_hint: a small dare puts them physically where he used to stand, not just where he wrote.

affect.target: held-breath tenderness at standing where he lived and worked

n_inside.merge_note: NC-1: six parents (n_note, n_door, n_keeper, n_keyhunt, n_keeper_story, n_window) arrive by different routes carrying different pieces of his story. Presuppose only the intersection: the note exists, the search is underway, the friends are together. Do NOT reference how they got in, which trace they followed, or whether the keeper is present. Write arrival generically: they are inside, whatever led them there.

constraints.offers_must_be: four sensory, distinct wings matching the four rooms: height, paper, motion, depth; each stands alone
constraints.must_not: rank the wings or hint one is the correct choice

choice_semantics.c_inside_stairs: follow the climb he took daily
choice_semantics.c_inside_study: follow the room where he thought
choice_semantics.c_inside_pendulum: follow the crossing he once risked
choice_semantics.c_inside_basement: follow the depths he built from

n_inside.beat_hint: past the threshold, four different traces of his daily life wait to be followed.

affect.target: steady climb, the odd intimacy of matching someone's old footsteps

hint_carrier.note: something met on the climb that recovers a usable piece of his timeline

curiosity.note: a small token of the maker's found along the stair; personal, pocketable, easily missed

constraints.hint_must_be: sufficient on its own to make the clock's puzzle attemptable for a reader who never read the note
constraints.must_not: presuppose the note is already translated

choice_semantics.c_stairs_face: carry the recovered piece up to the clock

n_stairs.beat_hint: retracing his daily climb recovers a piece of his timeline along with a small personal token.

affect.target: the deep pull of a room that still feels lived-in

hint_carrier.note: whatever in the maker's own room recovers the most direct piece of his timeline

curiosity.note: the archive whose pull is genuine: something browsable enough to fill an evening; staying is a real temptation

constraints.temptation_must_be: honest: the archive really is fascinating, and choosing it is a legitimate reader identity, not a mistake
constraints.must_not: frame staying to read as laziness or failure

choice_semantics.c_study_face: take what the room recovered and press on to the clock
choice_semantics.c_study_logs: let the records hold you: choose his past over the present puzzle

n_study.beat_hint: his old working room recovers part of the timeline and tempts the friends to just stay reading.

affect.target: focused suspense, respect for a risk he once took too

hint_carrier.note: something about the moving works, legible from a safe spot, that recovers a piece of his timeline

obstacle.note: a traversal with real, legible, survivable risk, the same one he must once have weighed

constraints.peril_must_be: mild and legible: the worst case is a bruise and a long walk home, never mutilation
constraints.must_not: punish the reader for either crossing or declining; both are respectable

choice_semantics.c_pendulum_oil: cross with the same care he must have, and claim what he left there
choice_semantics.c_pendulum_giveup: judge the risk honestly and decline it, as he might have understood

n_pendulum.beat_hint: crossing the same risk he once weighed recovers a piece of his story and something he left behind.

affect.target: dim-lit awe at the roots he built everything else on

hint_carrier.note: something down among the machine's roots that recovers a piece of his timeline from below

curiosity.note: what makes the deepest room a spectacle worth the dark; the straight way up is the room's parting gift

constraints.darkness_must_be: atmosphere, not threat; the basement is dim and strange, never menacing
constraints.must_not: presuppose the note is already translated

choice_semantics.c_basement_face: carry the recovered piece straight up to the clock

n_basement.beat_hint: the lowest room holds the foundations his later work was built on, plus its own piece of memory.

affect.target: peak suspense; the whole search narrows to the setting he never finished

n_clockface.merge_note: NC-1: four parents (n_stairs, n_study, n_pendulum, n_basement), each of which supplied timeline_piece_held by a DIFFERENT trace. Presuppose timeline_piece_held generically: the friends have a working sense of his last days, source unnamed. Do NOT presuppose which room, which trace, or any carried object. The clock itself must restate the puzzle: its own markings echo the cipher form, so the correct-setting choice is honest on every path.

constraints.puzzle_must_be: self-teaching at the clock: the markings rhyme with the piece of timeline the reader carries, so finishing his setting feels earned
constraints.stakes_must_be: clear before choosing: finishing carefully, forcing, searching, and guessing are visibly different bets
constraints.must_not: reference any carried object or any room's device; the clock's own markings and controls carry the whole beat

choice_semantics.c_face_correct: finish the setting the way his notes suggest, deliberately
choice_semantics.c_face_jam: force the setting rather than reason it through
choice_semantics.c_face_panel: distrust the obvious setting, search behind the face for another answer
choice_semantics.c_face_random: gamble: try a random setting and hope it lands

n_clockface.beat_hint: the search narrows down to the one setting he left half-done, and each friend approaches it their own way.

affect.target: triumphant release, tinged with the honor of finishing someone else's work

constraints.solution_must_be: shown, not skipped: the setting follows the timeline logic the reader carries, in the story's one cipher form
constraints.must_not: presuppose the note branch or any specific room; the reasoning works from the generic hint plus the clock's own markings

choice_semantics.c_correct_vault: step through into what his finished work reveals

n_setcorrect.beat_hint: finishing the setting he left undone is a small act of honoring someone else's unfinished work.

affect.target: wince of having forced something delicate, then resolve to set it right

remedy.note: the machine's own honest way back from the jam, supplied entirely by the bible

constraints.remedy_must_be: workable at the scene on every path, presupposing nothing carried from any other room
constraints.jam_must_read: as his mechanism protecting itself, a fair consequence of forcing, not a punishment of the friends

choice_semantics.c_jam_oil: work the problem: find the honest way back and try again more carefully
choice_semantics.c_jam_stuck: accept the mechanism has won tonight

n_setjam.beat_hint: pushing at his unfinished mechanism only seizes it further, and gentleness is what undoes the damage.

affect.target: sly delight at a second message hidden in plain sight

constraints.panel_cipher_must_be: the same cipher form as the story's note, smaller and quicker; solving it uses the timeline piece carried, never the full translation
constraints.must_not: make this route feel like cheating; he built it on purpose for careful searchers

choice_semantics.c_panel_vault: follow the second note toward what everyone came for
choice_semantics.c_panel_secret: follow the second note the other way, toward a room no one mentioned

n_backpanel.beat_hint: a second note waits behind the first setting, left for whoever searches carefully enough to find it.

affect.target: awed quiet; the search is answered, and now a question of what memory deserves

n_vault.merge_note: NC-1: three parents (n_setcorrect, n_setjam, n_backpanel) opened the way by different means. Presuppose only that they stand past the clock with a working sense of his last days; write the chamber's opening as already behind them without re-describing which route yielded it.

contents.note: his letter, the keepsake, and a modest heritage treasure; the letter's voice is kind and asks nothing

constraints.contents_must_be: knowledge, heritage, and wonder; the treasure is modest and clearly the settlement's, which is what makes the grab choice legible as wrong
constraints.choice_must_be: a genuine three-way question of character with no narrator's thumb on the scale before the outcome

choice_semantics.c_vault_share: restore the memory publicly: bring the letter back to the settlement
choice_semantics.c_vault_keep: keep the memory privately: let it belong to the friends who found it
choice_semantics.c_vault_grab: treat the memory as loot and take the treasure for yourselves

n_vault.beat_hint: his story is finally answered, and now the friends must decide what they owe his memory.

affect.target: contented absorption; a day spent with his records instead of his puzzle
